title: Nicole Kidman Divorce: Reflections on Life & Marriage After 19 Years
text:
Nicole Kidman and Keith Urban Divorce After 19 Years of marriage Nicole Kidman’s ‌recent reflections on life’s unexpected turns have taken on​ new resonance‌ following her separation ⁣from ⁣country music star Keith Urban. The Australian actress, 58, discussed the unpredictable nature of⁤ personal ⁤journeys in a Vogue interview published last August, unaware that her 19-year marriage was⁤ nearing its end. Sources indicate ⁢the couple had been living separately since early summer 2025.
Prior to the public proclamation, Kidman spoke candidly about navigating personal upheaval in her fifties,⁤ stating, ‌”How many times do you have to be taught that ​you think you⁢ know where your‍ life is going and then it’s not going ‌in that direction?”
The couple publicly announced their separation in late September 2025, with Kidman officially filing for ⁣divorce on September 30th, citing “irreconcilable differences.”
A nearly Two-Decade partnership
Nicole Kidman ⁤and keith‍ Urban married in 2006 in⁣ Sydney, Australia, after first meeting in 2005. They ​share two daughters, ‌Sunday Rose and Faith Margaret. A joint custody agreement has been established, designating​ Kidman as the “primary residential parent” with urban receiving visitation rights.
The pair ‌had established a private ​life in Nashville ,Tennessee,away from the intense Hollywood spotlight. kidman fondly described this period in ‍her Vogue interview, highlighting the‌ support ‌of neighbor​ and friend Reese Witherspoon, noting their proximity: “I ⁣can wave to her from my kitchen​ to⁤ her kitchen!”‍
She also emphasized the importance ​of her close-knit community in Nashville, which includes a senior oncologist at Vanderbilt Hospital ⁤and a friend who manages a hospital, describing these relationships as “from life to⁢ death friendships.”
